hypothesis_tested: D-128 boot-sequence hypothesis: an early reset makes XBL/ABL believe display is already initialised, so the next boot skips it and the UEFI read lands on an unpowered domain
hypothesis_result: rejected as the cause of the stall; a true power cycle that never boots Android still stalls at the same two-load probe

display_window_read_ledger_2026_10_24.note: 5 trials, resets before any DXE driver is dispatched

main_judgement: after 16:03 the display window became unreliable to read (1 clean, 3 stalled), a full power cycle does not restore it, and two loads are enough to hang. Until access is reliable again nothing inferred from reading that window can be trusted, so adding further probes has no value.
what_would_refute_it: a third trial that returns cleanly without any change in procedure would show the failures are still sporadic rather than a persistent state
candidates_next: leave the device powered off for well over ten minutes, then repeat the same single-load probe once
verify offline whether XBL/ABL actually initialises the display domain before a fastboot boot, and what the firmware may assume
stop read-based probing and build a reliable observation channel; note the on-screen text backend still depends on GOP, which itself may need the same window
interpretation: 第二次硬停。冷启动未清除挂死,D-128启动序列假设被证伪。16:03前后对照从7连成功变成1成功3挂,且2次读即挂,说明当前设备状态下显示窗口访问本身不可靠;在恢复可靠访问前,任何基于读该窗口的显示结论都不可信。
